name: El Masnou (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, dark blue and yellow.
history: The flag was approved initially by the municipal council on 19 September 2002 and definitively on 18 October 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, a horizontal tricolour of white, dark blue and yellow, colours taken from the arms of the town and representing the air, the sea and the sand.
